featured_reviews.name: Divya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took my computer-based IELTS exam here recently, and honestly, the overall experience was just average—especially considering the exam cost over ₹18,000.

The examiners and the staff handling IDs and photos were professional and polite, which I appreciated. The test itself went smoothly, and when one student’s computer crashed, the staff helped her quickly, which was great to see.

However, the front desk staff were quite rude and unfriendly. They kept pushing us to leave a Google review, which felt forced and uncomfortable. The center itself is also quite small—just a tiny waiting area, three speaking rooms, and one room for computer-based tests. I’m not sure if they conduct written tests here.

What really irritated me was the coordinator during the exam. He kept interrupting us with instructions, read super fast from a script, and made it hard to focus during the listening and reading sections.

Overall, a very okay-ish experience. The test setup was fine, but the staff attitude and environment could use a serious upgrade.

featured_reviews.name: Sahil Tanna
featured_reviews.review_text: This staff was very helpful and responsible for conducting the test, and they provided with any help needed as well as the latency for the speaking test, which was conducted on a video call. One of the video calls was also really good, and I didn't have any issue doing that. The setup also had required immunity as well as provided water during the test, so it was a good centre for me.

featured_reviews.name: Prajakta Godse
featured_reviews.review_text: The staff is courteous, patient and helpful. Everything about this test centre is good, except for the hardware for the computer-based test. The scrolling part of the mouse was a little stuck too. I asked for a different keyboard which was provided right away. These few things hindered the test experience a little. A change of monitors would make it a significantly better experience.
